product_one_liner.value: Bizagi provides a low-code business-orchestration platform that helps enterprises design, automate, and govern business processes and applications, including AI-enabled workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: Company overview describes its platform as business orchestration combining low-code, process execution, AI, and governance.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes consumption-based pricing and how it works, even though it does not show fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: Both company names appear in Bizagi customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: Bizagi's LinkedIn company profile lists a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Bizagi labels its Washington DC office as its Corporate Headquarters; its listed street address is in Tysons, Virginia.

founded_year.notes: Bizagi's company history says it was founded in Bogotá in 1989.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is organized around general topics such as AI, low-code, digital transformation, and process automation; it does not show the required set of at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Bizagi has a public Platform Help documentation site with numerous product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists an open “AI-First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure)” role.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI (Azure Private OpenAI GPT service)
model_provider.notes: Bizagi's AI documentation says it embeds Azure's Private OpenAI GPT service in its automation suite.

compliance_certs.notes: Bizagi claims ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and describes HIPAA/HITECH and GDPR compliance. The cited Trust Center content does not claim SOC 2 or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The reported round was a $48 million minority investment by Invus, announced in September 2017.

raised_18mo.notes: The identified latest funding was in September 2017, well before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists active roles but none titled SDR, BDR, Sales/Business Development Representative, or Account Executive. A separate BDR listing was marked removed in June 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi's Summer 2026 product release was released July 21, 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile lists Samir Gulati's Bizagi CMO tenure as ending in April 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Bizagi's connector marketplace documents both HubSpot and Salesforce connectors.
